CardDescription.DefaultText: A natural crossroads in the forest where game trails converge, marked by badger sett-diggings along the banks.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Pine Clearing: Conditions: Acidic soil. Flora: Pines, Birch, Appleweed, Healer's Moss, Fireroot, Pine Nuts (autumn), Fly Agaric, Meadowgrass. Fauna: Squirrels are the more common sight along this trail; badger setts dug into the banks nearby mark the den the diggers keep to by day.
